_evidence: 0x0040adc2 walks segment records (0x160 bytes at 0x8943a0) until the cursor EQUALS a computed stop record, so the two cursors of each walk must lie on the same side of the pit start [0x891500]. Walk 1 (or +0x48/+0x92 |= 1): stop = [0x866ef0]+4 records, wrapped by the lap length [0x866ec4] at the lap end [0x866ecc] when [0x866ef0] < pit start, else clamped to pit end [0x866ef8]-1; the cursor starts at the pit entry [0x866f00] and steps forward, at/after the lap end wrapping below the pit start or clamping at the pit end. Walk 2 (|= 2): stop = [0x866ef4]-4, wrapped up by the lap length below the lap start [0x891504] (lap side) or raised to the pit start (pit side); the cursor steps back from the pit exit [0x866f04] the same way. In the game 0x00559c37 derives [0x866ef0] by walking forward from [0x866f00] (and [0x866ef4] backward from [0x866f04]) with these same rules, so each bound lies on its cursor's trajectory: a lap-side cursor cycles the lap and never meets a pit-side stop (and vice versa), which loops forever in the original (the independent draws of win_0042b10d+ring_0040aec5). The layout features cannot correlate two draws, so the side is selected through the single pit-start draw: all four cursors are records 4..7 (within 4 records of each other, as on the game's trajectories), the lap is records 2..9 (start 0x894660, end 0x895160, length 0xb00, coherent), and the pit start is record 11 or 12 (after the lap end, as in the game: every cursor is lap-side, stops 2..9, wraps both ways) or record 2..4 (every cursor at/after the pit start: pit-side, stops 8..11 or the clamp; this pit range overlaps the lap records, which the pit-side code never consults: no lap wrap is reachable there). The pit end is record 8..15 (A+4 >= end clamps, below it does not; in the lap case it is only the record 0x40aec5 finally marks). An exhaustive check of all 5*8*4^4 combinations terminates every walk within records 2..10. The 0x40aec5 tail steps back from [0x866f00] [0x62d22e]+1 times and forward from [0x866f04] [0x62d230]+1 times (dec/jns counts, track-header words, 0..47 as in ring_0040aec5) inside records 2..15 and marks the pit end; bytes +0x48 and +0x92 of records 0..15 are read-modify-written (any value).
